run_UpdateClang: run the script to download and unpack prebuilt clang binaries for the current platform
run_DownloadUrl: run a download of a URL into an output file with progress dots and retry logic
run_DownloadAndUnpack: run a download and extract a gzipped tar archive from a URL into an output directory
run_ReadStampFile: run a read of the stamp file to check the current clang build revision
run_WriteStampFile: run a write of a version string to the stamp file for tracking build state
